title: Magnifito launch film
caption: A 15-second launch film for Magnifito. HyperFrames renders four brand-title cards in Geist on a transparent layer; ffmpeg sets them over a drifting cream backdrop with a faint dot grid with eased reveals and synthesized whooshes.
prompt: Use the magnifito-promo skill to make a 15-second 16:9 launch film for Magnifito, a Bulgarian digital marketing agency (websites, social media, email, ads and automation). Brand: warm browns on cream (#7a584c, #ae8c72, #d8c6b4, #f0eadf), dark ink #2b1c17, the logo green #8acf31 used sparingly, Geist Bold from fonts/, and the real logo in assets/magnifito-logo.svg. Four scenes with the brand-title recipe: the logo with the tagline "Marketing with heart and value", the five services over an icon row, "One team from first idea to launch", and an end card with the logo and magnifito.com. Link every service statement to an approved claim in claims.json. Render the cards transparent with HyperFrames, composite them over a slow animated cream backdrop with soft rise-in transitions, and add whooshes on the cuts and a chime on the end card.
commands: ffmpeg -f lavfi -i "color=c=black:s=320x180:r=30:d=15,format=gray,geq=lum='255*exp(-(pow(X-(0.28*W+0.10*W*sin(T*0.5)),2)+pow(Y-(0.80*H+0.10*H*cos(T*0.4)),2))/(2*pow(0.26*W,2)))'" -f lavfi -i "color=c=black:s=320x180:r=30:d=15,format=gray,geq=lum='255*exp(-(pow(X-(0.80*W+0.08*W*cos(T*0.35)),2)+pow(Y-(0.18*H+0.08*H*sin(T*0.45)),2))/(2*pow(0.30*W,2)))'" -f lavfi -i "color=c=0xf0eadf:s=320x180:r=30:d=15" -f lavfi -i "color=c=black:s=1920x1080:r=30:d=0.04" -filter_complex "[0]format=gbrp,colorchannelmixer=rr=0.11:gg=0.15:bb=0.18[g1];[1]format=gbrp,colorchannelmixer=rr=0.05:gg=0.07:bb=0.08[g2];[2]format=gbrp[base];[base][g1]blend=all_mode=subtract[m];[m][g2]blend=all_mode=subtract,scale=1920:1080:flags=bicubic[soft];[3]format=gray,geq=lum='255*clip(1.9-hypot(mod(X,40)-20,mod(Y,40)-20),0,1)',loop=loop=-1:size=1,trim=duration=15,setpts=N/30/TB,format=gbrp,colorchannelmixer=rr=0.16:gg=0.2:bb=0.22[dots];[soft][dots]blend=all_mode=subtract,noise=alls=2:allf=t,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -t 15 -c:v libx264 -crf 12 -preset veryfast work/bg.mp4

ffmpeg -i work/bg.mp4 -i work/text.mov -i work/whoosh.wav -i work/chime.wav -filter_complex "[1]format=yuva420p,split=4[s0][s1][s2][s3];[s0]trim=start=0:end=3.5,fade=t=in:st=0.15:d=0.7:alpha=1,fade=t=out:st=3.15:d=0.35:alpha=1[t0];[0][t0]overlay=y='60*pow(max(0,1-(t-0.15)/1.1),3)':eof_action=pass[v0];[s1]trim=start=3.5:end=7.5,fade=t=in:st=3.55:d=0.7:alpha=1,fade=t=out:st=7.15:d=0.35:alpha=1[t1];[v0][t1]overlay=y='60*pow(max(0,1-(t-3.55)/1.1),3)':eof_action=pass[v1];[s2]trim=start=7.5:end=11,fade=t=in:st=7.55:d=0.7:alpha=1,fade=t=out:st=10.65:d=0.35:alpha=1[t2];[v1][t2]overlay=y='60*pow(max(0,1-(t-7.55)/1.1),3)':eof_action=pass[v2];[s3]trim=start=11:end=15,fade=t=in:st=11.05:d=0.7:alpha=1[t3];[v2][t3]overlay=y='60*pow(max(0,1-(t-11.05)/1.1),3)':eof_action=pass[v3];[v3]fade=t=in:d=0.4,fade=t=out:st=14.3:d=0.7,format=yuv420p[v];[2]asplit=3[w0][w1][w2];[w0]adelay=3250:all=1,volume=0.55[x0];[w1]adelay=7250:all=1,volume=0.55[x1];[w2]adelay=10750:all=1,volume=0.55[x2];[3]adelay=11250:all=1,volume=0.7[x3];[x0][x1][x2][x3]amix=inputs=4:normalize=0,aformat=sample_rates=48000:channel_layouts=stereo,apad,atrim=0:15,afade=t=out:st=14.3:d=0.7[a]" -map [v] -map [a] -t 15 -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/branded-promo.mp4
